_comment: Published list prices in micro-USD per MILLION tokens.
These are transcribed from vendor pricing pages, and a transcribed
price is a claim about the world that goes stale without any code
changing. Check them against the first real invoice and correct them
here — that is why this is a JSON file and not a dict in a module.
A model that is genuinely free carries explicit zeros. That is not
the same as a model being absent: absent raises, so a model nobody
priced can never be silently billed at nothing.
Everything Ollama serves, plus the mock. Zero because electricity is
not billed per token, and because a zero here makes the dev/prod cost
delta visible in one table rather than needing a second code path.
The list below is longer than the three models settings.py defaults to,
and that is not padding. UnpricedModelError fired on a real dev machine
the first time all three tiers were exercised: llama3.2:1b was pulled
and unpriced, so the request raised. That is the guard working — and the
fix is exactly this, a line of JSON. Add any model you pull.
